//! A crate that leaks its library across its boundary.

use contract_sdk::Project;
use parser_lib::Tree;
use parser_lib::nested as nest;

pub mod reading;

/// The crate's answer, which leaks the tree.
pub struct Answer {
    /// The tree.
    pub tree: Tree,
}

/// A name for the library's node.
pub type Node = parser_lib::Node<u8>;

/// A kind.
pub enum Kind {
    /// A leaf of the library.
    Leaf(parser_lib::Leaf),
}

/// Reads one tree.
pub fn read(tree: &parser_lib::Tree) -> Option<nest::Out> {
    let _ = tree;
    None
}

/// Visits a tree.
pub fn visit<V: parser_lib::Visit>(visitor: V) {
    let _ = visitor;
}

/// A port.
pub trait Port {
    /// Reads.
    fn read(&self) -> Tree;
}

impl contract_sdk::Walk for Answer {
    type Output = parser_lib::Tree;
}

impl Project for Answer {
    type Output = Tree;
}

pub use parser_lib::Exported;
